usage.summary:
Added the seeded driver and helper doubles. Hook, model, and ratified definitions remain unchanged.

Model checks pass; conformance fails on a real bug: replaying a handled `p1` failure sends another repair and changes attempt/count from 0 to 1, violating `CurrentAndOnce`.

Source inspection also confirms the cached-reply early return. The gate reports the duplicate-failure violation first. Allowing that step would break a ratified statement, so I stopped without weakening the model.

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The hook starts idle and each settled input or callback follows the bounded model.

pins.name: RepairReplyAccounted
pins.says: A finished reply containing a program during a pending repair must start a compile, send another counted repair, or show an error.

pins.name: TwoRepairsPerHuman
pins.says: At most two repair messages are sent per human message, and a new human message cancels the active compile and resets the allowance and repair state.

pins.name: CurrentAndOnce
pins.says: A result or failure for a superseded program, or the same previously handled object delivered again, makes no callback call and changes no round or viewer state.

pins.name: FinishedRoundIsClear
pins.says: The displayed attempt matches the internal counter, and accepting a model or showing an error leaves neither a counted attempt nor pending repair errors.

pins.name: InfrastructureIsNotRepaired
pins.says: A fresh timeout or compiler-loading failure for the current program shows an error and sends no automatic repair.

pins.name: SkipOnlyVisibleModel
pins.says: A program reply can be skipped only when its previously accepted model is still displayed and no repair is pending, so replacing that model removes the skip exemption.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: All sources, counters, phases, pending state and observed callback calls stay within their declared types for three programs and a two-repair limit.

pins.name: ModelAccepted
pins.says: A compiled model can be displayed and accepted.

pins.name: BudgetExhausted
pins.says: A program fault can show an error after both automatic repairs have been sent.

pins.name: TimeoutShown
pins.says: A timeout can be shown as an error.

pins.name: CompilerUnavailableShown
pins.says: A compiler-loading failure can be shown as an error.

pins.name: RepairReplyCompiled
pins.says: A program in a pending repair's reply can start a new compile.

pins.name: IgnoreCachedRepairReply
pins.says: The hook silently returns when a repair reply repeats the successful program still displayed, leaving the failing program's pending errors and counted attempt untouched.

pins.name: KeepAttemptAfterError
pins.says: A timeout during a repair shows an error but leaves the attempt counter set, as the current hook does.
